title: Noa Is My Senior and My Friend Anime Unveils Teaser Trailer
content: Noa Is My Senior and My Friend anime unveiled a teaser trailer on Saturday. The anime is set to premiere in 2027 with studio feel. animating the series. The anime stars Rina Kawaguchi as Noa Saotome and Tomoya Ito as Rihito Otsuka. A visual was released last month.
author: Anime Corner

title: Singer LiSA and Voice Actor Tatsuhisa Suzuki Announce Divorce
content: Singer LiSA and voice actor Tatsuhisa Suzuki announced on Saturday that they have divorced after nearly seven years of marriage. The announcements were made through separate statements on their respective official websites.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Korea's EBS TV Network to Premiere 5 Generative AI-Assisted Animated Series in December
content: South Korea's public educational broadcaster Educational Broadcasting System (EBS) will premiere five animated series created using generative artificial intelligence (AI) technology, beginning December 1. The series were selected through the broadcaster's 2026 Generative AI Animation Series Co-Production Project.
author: ANN

title: 'LONA' Announces Additional Cast
content: The official website for the LONA ( Laboratory of Optics and Neural Analysis ) original television anime announced additional cast on Saturday. The sci-fi original anime is scheduled to premiere in April 2027 on 28 MBS and TBS-affiliated stations in the Super Animeism TURBO programming block.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Wit Studio's Original TV Anime LONA Reveals 7 More Cast Members, Confirms April 2027 Debut
content: Wit Studio revealed on Saturday more cast members for LONA ( Laboratory of Optics and Neural Analysis ), a new original television anime by director Takashi Katagiri ( SPY×FAMILY Code: White film).
author: ANN

title: Living It Up in Another World Until I Get Bored Anime Announces Ending Song, January Debut
content: The staff for the television anime of author Fudaya Sanmongarasu and illustrator Tomozo 's Living It Up in Another World Until I Get Bored ( Isekai Dо̄raku ni Akitara ) light novel series revealed on Saturday the anime's key visual, information on its ending theme song, and its January 2027 premiere.

title: 'Kidou Senshi Gundam SEED Freedom Zero' Reveals Production Staff, Theme Song, Main Trailer
content: The official website for the Kidou Senshi Gundam SEED Freedom Zero ( Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Freedom Zero ) revealed production staff, theme songs, a main visual (pictured), and the main promotional video on Saturday.

title: Medaka Kuroiwa is Impervious to My Charms Season 2 Reveals Song Artists, January 5 Debut in Video
content: The staff for the second television anime season based on Ran Kuze 's Medaka Kuroiwa is Impervious to My Charms ( Kuroiwa Medaka ni Watashi no Kawaii ga Tsūjinai ) manga presented the full promotional video and a key visual on Saturday.

title: Gundam Seed Freedom Zero Anime's Trailer Unveils Theme Songs
content: The staff for Mobile Suit Gundam Seed FREEDOM ZERO , the prequel to the Mobile Suit Gundam Seed FREEDOM anime film, unveiled its full trailer and a new key visual on Saturday. The trailer announces and previews the theme song "Absolute Zero" by Takanori Nishikawa with t.komuro, and also announces the ending theme song…

title: 'Kage no Jitsuryokusha ni Naritakute! Movie: Zankyou-hen' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, Main Trailer, May 2027 Premiere
content: The Shadow's Gathering 4th Anniversary special livestream event revealed additional cast, staff, a key visual (pictured), and the main trailer for the Kage no Jitsuryokusha ni Naritakute! Movie: Zankyou-hen ( The Eminence in Shadow: Lost Echoes ) sequel film on Saturday.
